completedWork.details: 34 governance objects, 32 bounded parameters, and 12 scoped roles load through a fail-closed runtime startup gate.
The 33-state canonical proposal lifecycle has audit-hashed transition history and explicit separation of approval, timelock, submission, execution, verification, failure, and rollback.

Ed25519 signed vote envelopes bind chain, domain, proposal, voter, electorate snapshot, choice, operation, revision, nonce, timestamp, and expiry. Replay, duplicate, tamper, wrong binding, replacement, and withdrawal rules are enforced and persisted.

Ed25519 signed persistent delegation revisions bind chain, domain, delegator, delegate, scope, amount, operation, revision, nonce, start, expiry, direct-vote override policy, and superseded audit hash. Registration, redelegation, revocation, replay, self-delegation, multi-hop, cycles, historical snapshots, partial power, and double counting are enforced fail closed.

First-class Timelock records bind Proposal ID, exact ActionHash, earliest execution, bounded Grace deadline, public Notice evidence, execution manifest, cancellation, emergency pause, execution outcome, rollback, and an audit-hashed transition history. Early, expired, duplicate, tampered, unauthorized, or divergent operations fail closed.

First-class Upgrade records bind Proposal ID, scope, ActionHash, source commit, release, exact manifest, migration, rollback, canary, verification, execution receipt, rollback receipt, and an audit-hashed transition history. Duplicate manifests, conflicting active scopes, divergent restore state, and tampering fail closed; canary state remains eligible_not_run until independently evaluated.

Public read APIs expose proposals, signed vote revisions, electorate delegations, roles, parameters, timelocks, executions, upgrades, emergencies, treasury/provider proposal records, conflicts, appeals, audit, health, version, and metrics.

Governance state v6 persists vote, delegation, first-class Timelock, and first-class Upgrade state; v1 through v5 require explicit migrations. Runtime config v3 requires bounded Timelock Grace policy, and digest-valid tampering still fails closed.

verifiedBehaviors: signature tamper rejection with recomputed snapshot digest
signed delegation registration, redelegation, and revocation
delegation replay, tamper, self, multi-hop, and cycle rejection
partial delegation and direct-vote override without double counting
session delegator identity and scope binding
first-class timelock ActionHash and public notice binding
timelock submitted, expired, cancelled, and paused restart recovery
timelock tamper and proposal-state divergence rejection
first-class upgrade source, release, manifest, migration, rollback, canary, and verification binding
duplicate manifest, release identity, and active-scope upgrade conflict rejection
exact upgrade manifest execution and receipt correlation
failed upgrade execution and verified rollback receipt correlation
upgrade restart recovery and digest-valid tamper rejection
persistent upgrade transitions in public upgrades and audit views
v1 through v5 state migration rejection

truthfulClaims: Signed vote integrity is implemented and tested locally.
Persistent signed delegation integrity and electorate snapshot binding are implemented and tested locally.
Persistent Timelock integrity, Grace expiry, exact ActionHash cancellation, and single execution submission are implemented and tested locally.
Persistent Upgrade integrity, exact manifest execution, restart recovery, and execution or rollback receipt correlation are implemented and tested locally.
Upgrade canary eligibility is recorded, but no canary is reported as run or passed.
A passed vote is not reported as execution.
A submitted execution is not reported as verified.
Treasury and provider views expose proposal records only; they do not claim external execution.
Central chain execution, Explorer evidence, Monitor alerts, shared Testnet acceptance, and public deployment are not complete.
